original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve image edit. Edit this exact adult male full body studio portrait. User correction: his legs are still too short; increase leg length by approximately half to one head length, aiming about 0.7 head of extra leg length relative to the provided image. This must be a visible, moderate leg-length increase, creating balanced roughly 7.5 to 8 head tall proportions, not exaggerated long fashion legs. Preserve the exact recognizable face, middle-part wavy brown hair, expression, neck, shoulder width, muscular build, black crewneck knit sweater with long sleeves, black tailored trousers and black Chelsea boots. Keep the upper torso naturally compact. Lengthen both thighs and lower legs anatomically in balance, raise the apparent crotch/hip line relative to overall height; do not merely stretch the whole photograph or elongate the sweater, neck, arms, head, feet. Full person centered and front facing with relaxed arms and both hands naturally at upper thigh, same white seamless studio background and soft lighting. Reframe to fit the entire longer-legged figure, complete hair and boots, comfortably in a portrait 2:3 image. Retain photorealistic fabric, natural trouser folds, anatomy, detailed skin. No labels, no text, no watermark. Deliver one corrected portrait only.
